function: Communication-efficient over-the-air model aggregation: local updates compressed to L scalar random projections (randomized gradient estimation), summed over the air, and reconstructed at the parameter server (pp. 3-5).
system: UL-MU-SIMO: K single-antenna EDs (K up to 160, 10 per round), parameter server with 8 antennas; no RIS; 3GPP-based channel; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 3, 6).
method: Federated learning (FedAvg local SGD) of ResNet-18, supervised image classification; zeroth-order randomized gradient estimation compresses updates; receive beamformer by non-learned convex-concave optimization (pp. 3-5, 10).
data_channel: Simulated channel 'based on 3GPP standards [22], [38]' (TR 38.901 on p. 13), O2I model; data CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, Brain-CT, TinyImageNet, Dirichlet alpha 0.5 (p. 6).
test_conditions: Each run trains and tests ResNet-18 on one dataset with one K (20 to 160); K and dataset varied across separate runs; test accuracy on that dataset (pp. 6-9).
baselines: OtA-FL [6] (uncompressed over-the-air FedAvg), LoRA-OtA-FL (ranks 8, 16, 32), ZO-OtA-FL (Fed-ZO); no non-learned or ideal-aggregation baseline (p. 7).
metrics: Test accuracy versus communication rounds and versus total communication plus computation load in seconds; per-round communication and computation load (pp. 7-9).
complexity: Per-round computation load 2.24 s for Fed-ZOE versus 0.41 s OtA-FL and 3.82 s ZO-OtA-FL (Fig. 4, p. 7); compression ratio L/S about 0.07 percent; no complexity order.
q1_support: p. 6: "The configuration of the channel coefficients is based on 3GPP standards [22], [38]"; [38] is 3GPP TR 38.901 (p. 13) and the O2I model is used; scenario, fading profile and carrier are not specified.
q2_support: p. 9: "we study the effect of the number of EDs" (K = 20, 80, 160); each K and each dataset is a separate run, no trained model is tested in an unseen condition and no fine-tuning or transfer is reported.
q3_support: p. 7: "we implement the following baseline schemes": OtA-FL [6], LoRA-OtA-FL, Fed-ZO; all are FL training schemes, so the earlier published design OtA-FL [6] gives the learned side, but no non-learned comparator is reported.
q4_support: p. 7 (Fig. 4): "Comput. Load" in seconds per round, Fed-ZOE 2.24, OtA-FL 0.41, ZO-OtA-FL 3.82; p. 9: "the proposed method has a lighter computation overhead" than ZO-OtA-FL. How it was measured is not stated.
q5_support: p. 6: "Five different datasets are used ... CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, Brain-CT, TinyImageNet"; these are public datasets of the learning task alone, the channel is simulated, and no code or data link is given.
notes: Area 7: the problem solved is the over-the-air aggregation itself (compression that keeps superposition, plus receive combiner of Appendix A, p. 10, solved by non-learned convex-concave programming). Multi-antenna PS (N = 8, p. 6), so the system check passes.
